correctness.rationale: Indicator identity gives the exact permissible swap and preservation of the entire top set. Every top set has an explicitly feasible sorted representative. Every inversion relative to its two-block total order is a legal swap, establishing global fiber connectivity. Initial-top fiber is a singleton, while all others have a legal move in their representative. Degree counts use bijective removal of a fixed point or a unit excedance, and handshaking yields edge totals. Direct exhaustive checks for n<=8 and a separately implemented DSU checker for n<=9 passed; finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The new object is the induced Eulerian stratum in the ordinary adjacent-position transposition graph. The complete top-value fiber characterization, binomial number of components, unique isolated state at each k and edge count are not given by the inspected antecedents. Four targeted research-record semantic searches and multiple precise public literature searches were compared by mathematical implication. Absence of a retrieved result is not proof of universal novelty; alternatives remain an explicit risk.

value.rationale: The Eulerian layers of the permutahedron are a classical natural family but their reachability under exactly excedance-preserving adjacent swaps is a distinct structural question. The theorem gives all connected components for every length and k, a canonical constructive sorting process, binomial fragmentation, a sharp frozen configuration and an exact edge count. This resolves a motivated all-parameter reconfiguration classification beyond a narrow computation.
